Contest on Liberation War kicks off in Ctg
2015-01-16T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent, Ctg
https://www.thedailystar.net/contest-on-liberation-war-kicks-off-in-ctg-60210

A two-day competition began in Chittagong city yesterday aiming to imbue the youth with the spirit of the Liberation War and inform them about the country's history.

Prof Anupam Sen, vice chancellor of Premier University, Chittagong inaugurated the competition organised by the Research Centre for Bangladesh Freedom Struggle and Liberation War Trust Chittagong at Jela Shilpakala Academy.

In the inaugural ceremony, Dr Anupam said the Liberation War in 1971 was the greatest event in the history of the Bangali nation dating back over a thousand years.

Dr Mahfuzur Rahman, a freedom fighter and also president of Research Centre for Bangladesh Freedom Struggle and Liberation War Trust Chittagong, said they have organised the event to let the new generation know the history of the Liberation War of Bangladesh.

The competition features inter-school debate, inter-school quiz, photography, poster, short film, and idea generating rounds.

A total of 16 schools are taking part in the quiz, and 18 schools are taking part in the debate competitions.
